comparison.objective: Select required parts from a conveyor and assemble the photographed model while allowing distractors to leave the line.
comparison.physical_skill: Moving-part selection, optional temporary parking, multi-part placement, stacking, and assembly alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Four specified parts form the stable model on marked locations, all distractors exit downstream, and no part is held back long enough to jam the belt.
comparison.reason: This is the closest conveyor comparison, sharing state-conditioned intervention and non-intervention for other items. Its tested ability is nevertheless model-conditioned part selection and precise multi-part assembly; the candidate uniquely requires open-flap interference avoidance, sidewall support, and retention of loose contents during reject transfer. The shared conveyor pick primitive alone is insufficient for overlap.
